description: All-occurrence Shift-And matching over reconstructed LZW dictionary phrases, with crossing and in-phrase match summaries.

source.title: Shift-And Approach to Pattern Matching in LZW Compressed Text
source.reference: CPM 1999, Figure 4 and Lemmas 2–6; Encyclopedia of Algorithms DOI 10.1007/978-1-4939-2864-4_81
source.algorithm_attribution: Bit-parallel Shift-And transitions summarized over LZW dictionary phrases, including every occurrence offset.

input.dictionary_initialization: Code a denotes the singleton symbol a for 0<=a<alphabet_size.
input.special_code_rule: At each noninitial code, a value equal to the next unused dictionary code denotes previous_phrase followed by its first symbol; greater values are invalid.

output.encoding: little-endian signed 64-bit words [match_count,zero_based_start_offsets...] in ascending order

workspace.meaning: At most 47 dictionary phrase summaries, a 32-bit Shift-And state, ancestor-match links, and a staged result for at most 528 decoded symbols.

contract.lzw_code_stream: The dictionary begins with singleton symbols. For each code after the first, resolve an existing entry or the one next-code special case, then add previous_phrase plus first(current_phrase).
contract.phrase_transition: Each phrase stores the 32-bit Shift-And mask after all of its symbols, plus the short-prefix crossing mask and links to matching phrase prefixes of length at least the pattern length.
contract.compressed_search: At each phrase, report matches crossing its left boundary from the prior Shift-And state, then report fully internal matches through matching-ancestor links, and finally advance the state with the phrase mask.
contract.result_positions: All offsets are zero-based starts in the expanded text and are emitted in ascending order.
contract.empty_stream: A valid stream with zero codes returns the one-word byte output [0].
contract.bounds: At most 32 codewords expand to 528 symbols; the 32-bit mask and result staging are bounded accordingly.

oracle_method: The primary follows phrase summaries from the compressed-search algorithm. The independent verifier decodes the bounded LZW stream and directly compares every candidate substring.
